svg.title: API Connect in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures for API Connect: sub-second startup for the DataPower Nano Gateway at the API product level; an SLA of up to 99.95% on the Reserved Instance plan and 99.9% on the plans hosted on AWS; a 30-day free trial. Each figure is IBM's, from its API Connect page and its pricing page. IBM states no test conditions for the startup figure.
